topic: A sticky retag lets any writer of that URI write into the retag target
detail: SP-071.2.a1 asks that a later client re-ingest of a retagged source_uri lands in the retagged space, and spaces.Classify lets an override win over every rule. A session pinned to another job's space could then write its own text under that URI into the target space (or into public), which is a cross-space write. Options: (a) honor the override for orchd's own writers (docs sync, sources refresh) and for client writes from the operator or from a session whose space is the target, and refuse other client writes of that URI; (b) honor it for every writer as written. Recommendation: (a); the lane implements (a) unless the user picks (b).
